title: zcurve-evidential-v1 player output
description: A single evidential-value verdict for the set of significant z-scores.

has_evidential_value.description: True if the set reflects genuine underlying effects (evidential value); false if it is consistent with selection-for-significance over null/weak effects (no evidential value / p-hacked).

expected_discovery_rate.description: Optional. The player's estimate of the expected discovery rate (EDR), as zcurve would report it. Not scored; provided for reporting/auditing only.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the has_evidential_value verdict.
